## Loading Packages and Data

Load the necessary packages to visualise the migration database.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(spData)
library(countrycode)
library(flowmapblue)
library(flowmapper)

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

Load the data

```{r}

openAlex_migration <- read_csv("data_processed/openalex_2024_V1_scholarlymigration_countryflows_enriched.csv")

scopus_migration <- read_csv("data_processed/scopus_2024_V1_scholarlymigration_countryflows_enriched.csv")
```

## Data Preparation and Mapping

```{r}
countries <- spData::world
glimpse(countries)

countries %>% ggplot() + geom_sf()

ggplot() + geom_sf(data = countries) + geom_sf(data = st_point_on_surface(countries), color = "darkred")

```

Country Codes

```{r}

library(countrycode)

scopus_migration <- scopus_migration %>% 
  mutate(
    iso2codefrom = countrycode(iso3codefrom,
          origin = "iso3c",
          destination = "iso2c"),
    iso2codeto = countrycode(iso3codeto,
           origin = "iso3c",
           destination = "iso2c")
  )

```

First, we will visualise the migration flow using flowmapper. This is a static flow map

```{r}

names(scopus_migration)
glimpse(scopus_migration)


countries_locations <- countries %>% 
  st_transform(8857) %>% 
  st_point_on_surface() %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>% 
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geom)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geom)[, 2]
  ) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(
    name = iso_a2,
    x = lon,
    y = lat
  )

glimpse(countries_locations)
head(countries_locations)
```

```{r}
scopus_flows <- scopus_migration %>% 
  group_by(
    o = iso2codefrom,
    d = iso2codeto
  ) %>% 
  summarise(
    value = sum(n_migrations, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(o),
    !is.na(d),
    o != d
  ) %>% 
  semi_join(countries_locations, by = c("o" = "name")) %>% 
  semi_join(countries_locations, by = c("d" = "name"))

glimpse(scopus_flows)
head(scopus_flows, 10)
```

Now, let us plot

```{r}
library(flowmapper)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = countries,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "white"
  )

world_map <- add_flowmap(
  p = p,
  nodes = countries_locations,
  od = scopus_flows,
  k_nodes = 10
)

world_map

```

Let us also idntify the top 20 migration flows\

```{r}
top_flows <- scopus_flows %>%
  left_join(
    countries %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(o = iso_a2, origin = name_long),
    by = "o"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    countries %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(d = iso_a2, destination = name_long),
    by = "d"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(value)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  select(origin, destination, value)

top_flows
```

```{r}
country_flows <- bind_rows(
  scopus_flows %>%
    group_by(country = o) %>%
    summarise(outflows = sum(value), .groups = "drop"),

  scopus_flows %>%
    group_by(country = d) %>%
    summarise(inflows = sum(value), .groups = "drop")
) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    outflows = sum(outflows, na.rm = TRUE),
    inflows = sum(inflows, na.rm = TRUE),
    net_flow = inflows - outflows,
    .groups = "drop"
  )



country_flows <- country_flows %>%
  left_join(
    countries %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(country = iso_a2, country_name = name_long),
    by = "country"
  ) %>%
  select(country_name, inflows, outflows, net_flow)

country_flows %>%
  arrange(desc(net_flow)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

country_flows %>%
  arrange(net_flow) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

Visualize the net migration balance

```{r}
top_net <- country_flows %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(net_flow))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  mutate(
    country_name = reorder(country_name, net_flow)
  )

ggplot(top_net, aes(x = country_name, y = net_flow,
                    fill = net_flow > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "indianred"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Net sender", "TRUE" = "Net receiver")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Net Scholarly Migration by Country",
    subtitle = "Aggregated Scopus flows across the study period",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Net migration balance (inflows - outflows)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
